title: tetradium austrosinense
intro: Tetradium austrosinense, commonly known as Chinese Evodia or Wild Evodia, is a plant species in the Rutaceae family. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its multiple health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and anti-cancer properties. The therapeutic actions of Tetradium austrosinense are attributed to its ability to relieve pain, reduce fever, and aid in digestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include limonoids, flavonoids, and coumarins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
